attempted_claim: Let K be a knot in S^3 of Seifert genus 2 such that there is an orientation-preserving homeomorphism S^3_1(K) ≅ S^3_1(5_2), where 5_2 is the genus-one twist knot with Alexander polynomial 2t-3+2t^{-1}. Is K isotopic to the pretzel knot P(-3,3,8)?
decisive_failure: Computational evidence is explicitly non-rigorous: SnapPy numerics cannot certify homeomorphisms of the non-hyperbolic filled manifold; the Montesinos construction of P(-3,3,8) remained rotation-ambiguous with three distinct hyperbolic candidates; only one Alexander polynomial completed while others timed out; and no Sage or Heegaard Floer software was available, so no uniqueness proof or certified counterexample could be produced.
